about: The levels of the patch pyramid from index `from` on are plates of the place, and inside `hold` the first level belongs to them too. ONE BODY: two levels show the same bodies at every scale they share (assets-src/mercury/place/onebody.py, the recipe is plates.json `oneBody`). Outside `hold` (inner, outer, degrees from the spot) the bodies of every plate are the map's own first level reduced into the plate's frame, and only what is finer than the recipe's `fineDeg` is the place's. Inside `hold` the bodies are the place's own at every level, the first one included, so the first level stays in at every distance there and the globe's own relief shading stays out: no body changes places on the way down or up. What changes with the eye's height is the light alone. The levels hold the place's bodies in the hero's light: the first level's own picture above the recipe's widest band, the place's bands under it matched by rank to the hero's bands (to the hero's own crater where the place's first pit lies on it), the hero's colour. tone.png (the square of tilt.json, the same file in both sets, written by onebody.py) holds inside `hold` the place's own picture over that field and outside it the place's low tone over the map's. `tone.height` (radii above the ground, from, to) gives a share G that is 0 above the first and 1 under the second, smooth in the logarithm of the eye's height. Inside `deg` (inner, outer, degrees from the spot) the globe draws its own lit ground at G 0 and the level times tone.png times `gain` at G 1, which inside `hold` is the place's own picture as the close view shows it at the handover. Between them the two are mixed by G as powers (each raised by `tone.dark`, the first to the power 1 - G, the second to the power G), so in the dark, well under `dark`, the mix is a straight one. The first height lies just under the eye's height of the judged dive frame 717, so the hold and 717 show the levels in the globe's light alone. The price, seen beside the approved image: the judged hold frame 615 changes inside `hold`. The hero's ring crater at the spot stands there as the place's first pit, the same crater at about 0.7 of its size, and the place's second pit is a crater the hero does not have. `light` is an option of the globe (thin texels of the level before to a pixel: to, from, power) and null in this state.
